expired_notice_spend.description: Suppliers paid in the window whose every exact-matched notice ended before the window start; a risk indicator to investigate for spend after expiry without a recorded extension.
caveats: A newer contract or an approved extension may exist with no notice.

spend_vs_award.description: Suppliers matched to one live single-supplier notice whose annualised_estimate is at least the flag ratio times the award per year; a risk indicator to request variation approvals.
caveats: Awarded values may be estimates or maxima; a ratio above 1.25 is an indicator to request variation approvals, not a finding.

high_value_suppliers.description: Suppliers whose annualised_estimate enters the three-quotes tier: the population to request contract evidence for (contract, quotes, award approval), not a list of exceptions.
